blocks.content: This step is optional. Use Overview when you already have named segments and want one mode for every segment you select. Skip it when only the Default segment exists. Segments that already have auto-apply on are not listed, so there is nothing to select after you turn it on for Default. These are the same modes as for the Default segment.

1. Open **Adaptive Metrics**.
1. On **Overview**, click **Enable auto-apply** next to the **Segment** dropdown.
1. Select the segments. Segments that already have auto-apply on are not listed.
1. Select an **Auto-apply mode**. That mode applies to every segment you selected.
1. Click **Apply**.
